newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-W. Australia takes steps to deregulate gas.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-W. Australia takes steps to deregulate gas.

text.p: The Western Australia government said on Thursday the state cabinet had agreed to further deregulate the state's gas industry, giving smaller customers greater access to suppliers.

From January 1, 1998, direct access would be made available to customers using a minimum 250 terajoules a year at a single site and from January 1, 2000 to customers consuming at least 100 terajoules a year, the office of the state's Energy minister, Colin Barnett said in a statement.

"From January 1 next year, when access will be at the 500 terajoule level, 91 percent of gas sold in Wesern Australia will be open to competition, which will represent 94 percent of total gas sales in Western Australia," the statement said.
